About Zoox

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Contract Worker Program

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview

This role focuses on discovering long-tail events in Zoox fleet driving logs by combining data mining techniques with the latest AI and Vision Language Model (VLM) capabilities. You will work with Zoox’s rich AV driving data, define what makes a driving moment interesting, build curated datasets of rare scenarios, and identify scenes with value for feature development, and public storytelling.

Responsibilities

- Develop detailed scenario specifications and translate them into production level code to search AV fleet driving logs for long-tail events.

- Use the latest AI models and VLMs to filter candidate scenes.

- Review candidate scenes, take part in the end to end life cycle, improvement and maintenance of automated mining and triage tools.

Required Qualifications

- Build and maintain curated datasets of long-tail events that flag compelling scenes.

- Proficiency in Python and SQL.

- Hands-on experience with modern AI models or VLMs through APIs, coursework, or projects.

- Track discovery progress and communicate with stakeholders within and outside the core development team.

- Creative problem solving and strong communication skills.

Bonus Qualifications

- Experience with big data systems such as Spark.

- Robotics or AV data is a plus.

- Recommender systems and content curation.

Program Requirements

- Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.

- Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.

- Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week.

- Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.

- Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Contract Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Compensation for this role is $30/hour.

This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor.

About Zoox

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

/ ABOUT ATALANTA

Atalanta is a mathematical AI company bringing provably correct decision-making to the world’s most important missions.

Our flagship product, Argo, is the first platform in a new category called software understanding. Argo combines AI, formal methods, and digital engineering to help organizations design, implement, and deploy complex software-controlled systems with mathematical assurance at mission speed.

Backed by leading investors, Atalanta works with customers building and deploying mission-critical systems across energy, space, and defense. Our goal is to help engineers and mission owners move faster while maintaining the highest possible level of assurance, ultimately saving time, money, and lives.

To learn more, here are some pieces written by Atalanta’s founders that offer deeper context on the ideas behind the company’s mission:

- Back to the Building Blocks

- The AI Arms Race Will Be Won On Mathematical Proof

/ HOW WE WORK

Atalanta takes its name from the mythological Greek heroine, a swift and fearless competitor who defied expectations and joined the Argonauts on a mission few thought possible. Her spirit of speed, discipline, and resilience shapes how we work.

We’re building a team of modern-day Argonauts: exceptional engineers, mathematicians, designers, and strategists committed to solving the hardest, highest-stakes problems in the world. We move fast, but we do so with discipline and logic. We think from first principles and execute with autonomy and accountability.

You may be a good fit for Atalanta if you are insatiably curious in the face of discomfort, are a coalition builder who sees progress as a positive-sum game, and believe that the alchemy of interdisciplinary expertise can solve seemingly impossible problems.

/ ENGINEERING AT ATALANTA

Software understanding is about building systems that perform reliably in real-world missions where failure has consequences. It requires proving that those systems behave correctly in ways that enable reliable decision-making under real-world conditions. This cannot be achieved through traditional software development alone, nor through formal methods in isolation. Atalanta’s engineering function is built on a deliberate combination of forward-deployed engineers, formal methods engineers, and software engineers, each working directly against real mission problems and real user needs: deploying into operational environments, establishing provable guarantees, and building scalable systems. This work is defined by deep mission and customer obsession, where real-world use drives what gets built and which problems matter. Engineers take a product-first approach, translating these insights into systems that can be deployed quickly across constrained and high-stakes environments. These roles operate in close coordination, ensuring that Argo continuously evolves through use in the field. Success means solving problems that were previously considered impossible, and turning them into capabilities that can be productized at scale.

/ ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineering Intern at Atalanta you will work alongside our forward deployed engineers to bring Argo into customer environments and help users apply formal methods to their own systems. You will help model real customer architectures and code, build the integrations and interfaces that make verification results usable, and see firsthand how feedback from the field shapes the product. This role combines technical skill, user empathy, and clear communication to support missions that matter.

In this role, you will:

- Support forward deployed engineers in deploying and configuring Argo for customers across cloud, on-prem, or hybrid environments.

- Help translate customer system data and architecture artifacts into schemas and models that formal methods tools (SMT and SAT solvers, theorem provers) can reason about.

- Prototype and evaluate LLM-powered workflows, including prompt design and tool calling, that connect customer data to automated reasoning.

- Build and test front-end features and internal tools that make system models, constraints, and verification results understandable and actionable for customers.

- Turn what you learn from customer engagements into documentation, product feedback, and contributions to Atalanta’s forward deployment playbook.

- Strong programming fundamentals in at least one language such as Python, TypeScript, or Rust, and familiarity with, or willingness to learn, front-end frameworks like React.

- Experience building software for real users through coursework, prior internships, research, hackathons, or personal or open source projects.

- Interest in AI systems and formal methods, such as LLM tool calling, agentic workflows, SMT solvers, or theorem provers like Lean; prior exposure is a plus but not required.

- Strong communication skills and an interest in working directly with users to understand their problems and explain technical results clearly.

- Eligibility for a TS/SCI security clearance (U.S. citizenship required.)

The salary for this position is estimated to be $100,000 to $150,000 per year, prorated for the duration of the internship.
